claim@1.summary: Claim the item so no other session builds it at the same time.

start@1.summary: Move the item to its in-progress status.

branch@1.summary: Create the item's branch from its working base.

build@1.summary: Build the item on its branch and hand back what was deferred, changed or dismissed.

risk-check@1.summary: Check the finished build for the risks its changes carry, and fix or raise what it finds.

local-checks@1.summary: Run the repository's local checks on the final tree and leave a receipt.

review@1.summary: Review the change with the configured reviewers and settle every finding.

merge@1.summary: Land the reviewed change on its target.

complete@1.summary: Record the landed work on the item: its status, dates, links and claims.

capture@1.summary: File the follow-up work the build, the risk check and the review left untracked.

sync@1.summary: Bring the working base up to date and confirm the tree is clean.

custom@1.summary: A repository's own step: it passes, fails or holds, with evidence.

hotfix-preflight@1.summary: Check the working tree and name the hotfix branch from the repository's config.

hotfix-branch@1.summary: Cut the hotfix branch from the production branch and push it.

hotfix-stage@1.summary: Name the environment this checkout deploys to, and stop before touching a production one.

hotfix-environment@1.summary: Bring the local environment back to production code: a backward transition.

hotfix-report@1.summary: Report the cut in one line and say what comes next.

hotfix-fix@1.summary: Make the smallest change that fixes the production problem, then commit and push it.

hotfix-merge@1.summary: Merge the reviewed hotfix pull request into the production branch, only on the person's yes.

deploy-approval@1.summary: Approve the production deploy of one merge, only on the person's yes for that merge.

deploy-confirm@1.summary: Confirm production serves the merge, or ask the person to confirm it.

hotfix-close@1.summary: Close out the hotfix and say whether an open release branch must take it.

release-shape@1.summary: Say whether this release is new, an open release to adopt, or a merged one to close out.

tower-claim@1.summary: Claim release clearance from the tower, waiting while another release holds it.

merged-release@1.summary: Find the newest merged release and recompute its delta.

train-claim@1.summary: Claim the release train so only one session runs it.

ground-truth@1.summary: Fetch both branches and read what other sessions landed.

ci-hold-proof@1.summary: Prove pull-request CI waits for the ready flip before a release opens.

train-finish@1.summary: Finish the items an earlier merged release train carried.

ship-plan@1.summary: Wait a bounded time for work a peer says is nearly ready for the train.

train-snapshot@1.summary: Cut a snapshot of the release train merged with the release source.

train-pr@1.summary: Open the release train's pull request into the release source.

train-review@1.summary: Review what no landing receipt covers on the train pull request.

train-pre-ship@1.summary: Run the local pre-ship checks the train needs.

train-merge@1.summary: Merge the train pull request through the merge gate, never a push.

train-close-out@1.summary: Mark the one-offs the train carried as reached.

train-level@1.summary: Bring the release train level with the release source.

release-delta@1.summary: Work out what the release carries and check its holds.

classify-release@1.summary: Say whether the release is light or full; anything unclear is full.

classify-at-checks@1.summary: Classify the release again at the head the checks test.

classify-at-pre-ship@1.summary: Classify the release again at the reviewed head before the pre-ship checks.

tower-queue@1.summary: Wait in the release queue behind any older release pull request.

release-branch@1.summary: Cut the protected release branch from the release source.

production-in-branch@1.summary: Merge production into the release branch when it is behind.

release-pr@1.summary: Open the release pull request into production as a draft.

train-claim-hand-on@1.summary: Hand the train claim on once the cut exists so the next release can start.

release-tip@1.summary: Record the production tip the checks run against.

pre-ship-at-checks@1.summary: Run the release's pre-ship checks before claiming the tower.

dev-deploy-wait@1.summary: Wait for the staging deploy of the release commit to be serving.

pre-merge-at-checks@1.summary: Ask whether production needs anything before the merge, at the checks head.

release-stamp@1.summary: Stamp the head, tree and production tip the checks passed on.

release-review@1.summary: Run the full production-release review and settle it.

pre-ship-release@1.summary: Run the release's pre-ship checks at the reviewed head.

pre-ship-resume@1.summary: Discharge the review's pre-ship hold, which flips the pull request ready once.

release-docs-plan@1.summary: Plan which documentation hooks run after the deploy is confirmed.

hotfix-catch-up@1.summary: Merge a hotfix that reached production into the release branch.

previous-release@1.summary: Check the previous release's post-deploy status before merging.

pre-merge-check@1.summary: Ask whether production needs anything before the merge.

pre-merge-recheck@1.summary: Ask the pre-merge question again once the tower is claimed.

owner-go-ahead@1.summary: Show the recap and take the owner's yes or the standing yes before the production merge.

release-stamp-verify@1.summary: Verify the checks stamp still matches the branch and production.

rerun-at-merge@1.summary: Re-run the pre-ship entries marked to run again at the merge.

merge-confirmations@1.summary: Confirm the head, CI, pre-ship results, threads and tower before the merge.

production-merge@1.summary: Merge the release into production through the merge gate, never a push.

post-deploy-pending@1.summary: Post the pending post-deploy status on the merge commit.

estimates-score@1.summary: Score the estimates the shipped items carried.

tower-hand-back@1.summary: Hand release clearance back to the tower, naming what is still owed.

post-deploy-result@1.summary: Post the health check's result as the release/post-deploy status.

release-sync@1.summary: Sync production back into the release source.

release-branch-delete@1.summary: Delete the release branch once both branches contain it.

release-docs@1.summary: Publish documentation for the shipped release and settle the docs owed item.

release-kb-sync@1.summary: Refresh the knowledge base after documentation was published.

release-close-out@1.summary: Run the post-deploy close-out when the health check said one is owed.

release-notes@1.summary: Write release notes, only when they were asked for.

release-recap@1.summary: Write the plain-language recap of the release.

auto-start@1.summary: Decide whether the next release starts now.
